changelog: V12.2 adds full project-folder synchronization to the Developer Mode GitHub manager.
New files are added, changed files are updated, and unchanged files are skipped.
GitHub branch references are resolved to commit and tree SHAs before listing or synchronization.
Sensitive local settings, credentials, caches, virtual environments and generated files are excluded.
Remote files that are absent locally are preserved and are not deleted.
The English installer verifies the downloaded launcher with SHA-256 and installs Python when required.
